decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 9th October 2006, the erection of a single storey rear extension to replace the existing conservatory to house, with the dimensions of the new rear extension being 4.3m in width, 2.3m in depth and 2.8m in height; new skylight being 2.3m in width, 980mm in depth and 250mm in height; which includes part of the original cloak room, and the existing loft being 5.4m in width, 3.65m in depth, and 2.5m in height, as shown on drawings numbered SV(0)101, SV(0)102, PL(0)201 and PL(0)202, received 9th October 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

Following the proposed extensions consisting of a single storey rear extension, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension to replace the existing conservatory to house
